Expected fills when signals exist: entry at the signal order time + 1.0 s (market, walking the book), stop/target as in the SIGNALS table, session-end exit 16:00 ET (UWTime) executed 1.0 s later.

## INPUTS

- Rule: ATR14 = Wilder RMA of the true range (first value = simple mean of the first 14 true ranges, then (prev x 13 + TR)/14; TR uses the previous bar close; the very first bar uses its own close); LL40 / HH40 = lowest low / highest high of the last 40 bars INCLUDING the current bar; upper = LL40 + 4.0 x ATR14; lower = HH40 - 4.0 x ATR14 (levels in force at the bar; NaN until 40 bars exist). outside-up = close > upper, outside-down = close < lower. FADE = event when the PREVIOUS bar was outside and this bar is not: SHORT after an upper-outside bar, LONG after a lower-outside bar (a bar with both is dropped). The whole bar series of ALL sessions is one continuous series (no session reset); signals only from NY PM bars (code 4, 12:00-16:00 ET), part = 0; order time = floor(known second) + 2 s; events at or after 16:00:00 ET (from the bar known time) are dropped. The first row of the table is the preceding bar (it carries the previous-bar state).
